spots.name: Panorama Salland
spots.blurb: You've reached Panorama Salland, a mural by Schilderclub Mariënheem from 2013. Landschappelijk schilderij over de volle oppervlakte van deze zijkant. Met links huis Sprengenberg te Haarle, met de markante 'Palthetoren'.

spots.name: Untitled mural
spots.blurb: You're at a mural that has been mapped here. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.
